==Overview==
This template is used to shorten the citations used by the visual guides ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''.
==Usage==
<pre>{{GuideDate|guide|before_after|year|event}}</pre>

*{{param|1|guide}}: The guide that you are using the template for. "Solo" is for ''Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide'', "ROS" is for ''Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary'' and "RO" is for ''Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide''.   '''Required'''.
*{{param|2|'''A''' or '''B'''}}. Determines whether the template will render to say the year as "before" or "after" the event the guide uses as a basis for its dating system. '''Important note''' the parameter "A" may only be used with ''Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary'', otherwise the template will return an error message. '''Required'''.
*{{param|3|years}}. How many years before or after the event listed in the guide. '''Required'''.
*{{param|4|Title of the event}}. The name of the event. '''Required'''.

===Examples===
<pre>{{GuideDate|RO|B|51|[[Orson Callan Krennic|Orson Krennic]]'s [[Reproduction|birth]]}}
</pre>
{{GuideDate|RO|B|51|[[Orson Callan Krennic|Orson Krennic]]'s [[Reproduction|birth]]}}

<pre>{{GuideDate|S|B|22|[[Han Solo]]'s [[Reproduction|birth]]}}
</pre>
{{GuideDate|Solo|B|22|[[Han Solo]]'s [[Reproduction|birth]]}}

<pre>{{GuideDate|ROS|B|5|the [[First Order secession|secession]] of the [[First Order]]}}
</pre>
{{GuideDate|ROS|B|5|the [[First Order secession|secession]] of the [[First Order]]}}
